ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 15:85 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Prominent diagonal high-contrast white streak located on the central-left lobe; series of roughly parallel vertical white streaks on the central-right lobe; sparse white mottling concentrated along the trailing edge and near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 55 degrees; partially obscured at the vertex by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth serration across the entire span; pixel amplitude of indentations increases significantly toward the distal tips, particularly on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch through the mid-lobe, transitioning to a sharp concavity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-intensity white circular pixel clusters visible at the anterior edge of the left lobe and near the left distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One primary diagonal linear disruption (approx. 15% of fluke width) on the left lobe; a set of 4-5 parallel vertical linear marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significantly jagged and asymmetrical trailing edge topography, particularly the deeply notched and irregular right distal tip.
